flora: Primitive Flower (large, creamy-white to pale pink, thick waxy petals/tepals in a spiral)
Leathery Leaf (oval, dark green, with a glossy waxy coating to retain water)
Seed Cone (the center of the flower matures into a bumpy, cone-like fruit)
Bark detail (smooth, grey-brown, with small horizontal breathing pores called lenticels)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; focus on the 'waxy' and 'thick' textures; vibrant but natural colors; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: The open, spiral-petaled flower; Top-Right: A single thick, glossy leaf; Bottom-Left: The green, bumpy fruit/seed pod; Bottom-Right: A close-up of the smooth grey bark.
visual_logic.ground: Sandy buff soil with a few slate-grey pebbles.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, bright daylight catching the 'sheen' of the waxy leaves and petals.
